branches.if: Exact article, relevant exposure/function question, adequate execution route and plausible contribution fit a credible narrow scope.
branches.then: Consider conditional qualification on remaining cost/time and retained value versus alternatives and waiting.
branches.scope_limit: No execution authorized; source sprint does not change APR/RM/BLU/NDC conditional order.

branches.if: Article, formulation, exposure or model cannot be qualified within the assumed envelope.
branches.then: Treat as qualification uncertainty; rescope, compare, wait or stop.
branches.scope_limit: No target-failure inference and no silent absorption of major new development.

branches.if: Qualified result supports useful established-lesion restoration with appropriate comparator advantage.
branches.then: Consider focused confirmation and product qualification.
branches.scope_limit: Not clinical proof, broad genotype coverage, commercial ownership or capture.

branches.if: Restoration is unsupported but a distinct prevention or ongoing-control benefit is credible and useful.
branches.then: Narrow and separately assess that claim with its exposure, tolerability, treatment burden, comparator and capture requirements.
branches.scope_limit: Do not relabel control as repair or count assembly/biomarkers alone as a product.

branches.if: Simpler therapy provides equivalent useful outcomes without an offsetting NDC advantage.
branches.then: Deprioritize commercial NDC development; other research objectives remain distinguishable.
branches.scope_limit: A distinctive mechanism does not rescue absent product contribution.

branches.if: Benefit is useful but exact commercial position is unavailable or terms absorb retained value.
branches.then: Do not fund as an owned drug asset; separately justify any research or contractual route.
branches.scope_limit: No inferred license availability or spending authority.

branches.if: No bounded new public document can change the action.
branches.then: Close source pass and retain the option to wait.
branches.scope_limit: Do not repeat generic patent, sponsor, exposure or model/catalog searches.

tranche_assumption.provenance: Independent marginal capital review,4Nov2026; illustrative analyst assumption
tranche_assumption.scope: Original assumption includes topical exposure and an established-barrier functional question; a readiness-only question is a distinct narrower tranche.
requirements_before_action: Exact article and adequate lawful execution position
Suitable material quality and practicable presentation
Qualified model and interpretable outcome for the intended claim
Credible cost/time responsibility and execution capacity
Meaningful comparator contribution and retained commercial route
excluded: Extended formulation or full CMC package
tranche_assumption.scope_change_rule: Reprice the changed question and compare remaining cost/time/value with alternatives and waiting; do not silently enlarge this envelope.
tranche_assumption.readiness_only_rule: Rescope and compare its actual cost, information value and priority with alternatives and waiting; do not assume the original functional-answer investment rationale survives.

claim_specific_amendment.target: Generic assembly/prophylaxis-only stop applied to the whole NDC product
claim_specific_amendment.replacement: Deprioritize established-lesion restoration if benefit is restricted to assembly/prevention in an adequately qualified interpretable comparison. Preserve a separate prevention or ongoing-control thesis only with credible useful functional or patient benefit, feasible exposure/tolerability, meaningful comparator advantage and credible capture. Assembly/markers alone do not establish that alternative. Model or delivery failure is not target failure.
claim_specific_amendment.positive_interpretation: Credible useful positive may justify focused confirmation before every ancillary uncertainty is resolved.
claim_specific_amendment.negative_interpretation: Require adequate article, exposure, deficit and precision; established-deficit modifiability is specifically required for an intended reversal claim.
